metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the ITG team

plugins.name: itg-tracker
plugins.description: Keeps the ITG Progress tracker list current: finds the work projects you worked on in Claude Code, drafts new rows and status updates, fills in your projects' notebook pages, and writes through Chrome after your yes.

plugins.name: versatex-pages
plugins.description: Builds Versatex-branded standalone HTML pages (guides, briefs, one-pagers) with the fonts and logo inside, ready for a phone, print or an email attachment, and checks them against the brand rules.
